summary: Petition under Section 79 (1) (c) of the Electricity Act 2003 read with Regulation 41 and 42 of Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Connectivity and General Network Access to the inter-State Transmission System) Regulations, 2022 for seeking relaxation of the date of 30.09.2024 which is stipulated under Regulation 19.2 of the said GNA Regulations for submission of the application for additional GNA for the financial year 2025-26, 2026-27 and 2027-28. The instant Petition is filed under Section 79 (1) (c) of the Electricity Act 2003 (hereinafter referred to as “the Act”) read with Regulation 41 and 42 of Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Connectivity and General Network Access to the inter-State Transmission System) Regulations, 2022 (herein after referred to as the “GNA Regulations”) for seeking relaxation of the date of 30.09.2024 which is stipulated under Regulation 19.2 of the said GNA Regulations for submission of the application for additional GNA for the financial year 2025-26, 2026-27 and 2027-28. - _d)Pass such other order/s, as this Commission deems just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case._ **3.** The Petitioner vide Petition dated 01.03.2025 has made the following submissions: - c) Soon after receiving clarification from the officials of CTUIL, the process of passing a new board resolution authorizing Sr. GM, RT&C, OPTCL, to apply for additional GNA was initiated on 24.10.2024. The post of CMD, OPTCL was vacant from 27.08.2024 to 10.11.2024. On 10.11.2024, an appointment was made to the post of CMD, OPTCL, and after completing all internal formalities, the agenda for board resolution was placed in the board meeting on 04.12.2024, and then on 20.12.2024, it was decided to authorize Sr. GM (RT&C), OPTCL, to apply for additional GNA. Thereafter, as per the requirement, OPTCL applied for a digital signature certificate of Sr. GM (RT&C) on 30.12.2024 after obtaining approval from its finance wing through SSA Future Info Service Pvt. Ltd., which issued the digital signature in favour of Sr. GM (RT&C) on 22.01.2025. - e) Regulation 41 Power to Relax of the GNA Regulations, 2022 as also Regulation 42 Power to Remove Difficulty of the GNA Regulations, 2022 vests this Commission with the power and judicial discretion to address situation like the present one where the Petitioner despite making efforts was not able to apply for additional GNA, as detailed above. It is submitted that this Commission, vide order dated 11.01.2025 in Petition No. 434/MP/2024, has already passed appropriate orders for the relaxation of applying for additional GNA. It is submitted that in view thereof, the deadline of 30.09.2024 could be relaxed in appropriate case/s and is not inflexible. It is reiterated that although OPTCL had taken steps to do the needful in a timely manner, on account of genuine difficulties, as detailed in the foregoing paragraphs, the same did not fructify. - a) In view of the above, the Petitioner is filing the present petition for direction to CTUIL to accept its additional GNA application for FY 2025-26. **4.** During the hearing, Petitioner submitted that he is seeking direction to CTUIL for allowing OPTCL to apply additional GNA for FY 25-26 after expiry of last date of 30 th September 2024 under the GNA Regulations since OPTCL had taken steps to do the needful in a timely manner, however, on account of genuine difficulties, the same did not fructify. Petitioner also submitted that this Commission, in a similar matter in Petition No. 434/MP/2024, has earlier given such relaxation. After hearing the submissions of the Petitioner, the Commission reserved the matter for order. **5.** We have considered the submission made by the petitioner and the facts available on the record. **6.** The Petitioner has submitted that GRIDCO Limited, vide email and letter dated 28.09.2024 and 30.09.2024 respectively, requested OPTCL, a STU in Odisha State, to apply for an additional GNA quantum of 130 MW from April 2025 onwards under Regulation 19.2 of the 2022 GNA Regulations. However, OPTCL was not able to apply for the additional GNA as the last date for such applications, as per the GNA Regulations, was 30.09.2024, and there were some procedural issues within OPTCL. The Petitioner has therefore approached this Commission to remove regulatory difficulties and relax the GNA Regulations. Furthermore, the Petitioner seeks directions from this Commission to the Nodal Agency (CTUIL) to accept and consider an additional GNA of 130 MW effective from FY 2025-26 till FY 2027-28. In this connection, the Petitioner has placed on record the order of this Commission, dated 11.01.2025, in Petition No. 434/MP/2024, wherein appropriate orders were **7.** We have considered the submission of the Petitioner. The issue that arises for our consideration is as follows: provisions of the GNA Regulations to remove the hardship in the operation of the GNA Regulations. Regulation 41 of the GNA Regulations is extracted as under: _The Central Commission, for reasons to be recorded in writing, may relax any of the provisions of these regulations on its own motion or on an application made before it by an affected party to remove the hardship arising out of the operation of these regulations_ .” “ _42. Power to Remove Difficulty If any difficulty arises in giving effect to the provisions of these regulations, the Central Commission may, on its own motion or on an application made before it by affected party by order, make such provision not inconsistent with the provisions of the Act or provisions of other regulations specified by the Central Commission, as may appear to be necessary for removing the difficulty in giving effect to the objectives of these regulations_ .” **10.** Considering the above, we allow the Petitioner’s prayer to apply by way of a fresh **11.** Petition No 353/MP/2025, along with, is disposed of in terms of the above.
title: Petition under Section 79 (1) (c) of the Electricity Act 2003 read with Regulation 41 and 42 of Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Connectivity and General Network Access to the inter-State Transmission System) Regulations, 2022 for seeking relaxation of the date of 30.09.2024 which is stipulated under Regulation 19.2 of the said GNA Regulations for submission of the application for additional GNA for the financial year 2025-26, 2026-27 and 2027-28. Odisha Power Transmission Corporation Limited (OPTCL)
